name: s'Ochsal
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to s'Ochsal in Tirol!**

Discover the heart of the Alps in **Tirol**, where breathtaking landscapes meet authentic traditions. Whether you're exploring the charming streets of **Innsbruck**, gliding down the slopes of **St. Anton** or **Ischgl**, or indulging in local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Tiroler Gröstl**, every moment here is pure magic.

**s'Ochsal** invites you to experience the best of **Tirol**—from cozy mountain huts to world-class skiing, from scenic hikes to vibrant festivals. Come and let the spirit of the Alps inspire you!

**Willkommen in Tirol!** 🏔️✨
